coverage_definition: Four target-specific successful routes in main Schemes 2/3 and SI section 3, including aryl partner preparations and separately tracked racemic oxidation control; literature preparation of 9/10/S7 and model optimization excluded

issues.detail: Known precursors are drawn and referenced, but their preparations are not reproduced in this paper. They are not invented or counted as extracted commercial-to-precursor routes.
issues.subject: 9/10/S7

issues.detail: Main Scheme 2 alternative oxidation is clarified by SI page 19 as rac-14 to rac-16. It is kept outside the enriched target routes.
issues.subject: E20

issues.detail: Multistep isolated yields belong to events. Individual crude intermediate stage yields are not inferred or copied from total yields.
issues.subject: E08/E09/E11/E13/E14/E16/E18/E20

issues.detail: 24 is an E/Z mixture (76:24); 25/26 are an inseparable crude mixture before selective Boc protection. Alcohol centers drawn wavy remain unspecified.
issues.subject: 24/25/26/S8/S10/S12

issues.detail: Named major configurations are represented by canonical SMILES. Measured ee values 83/87/84/84/85% are sample metadata; no enantiopurity or downstream propagation is asserted.
Table 1 model optimization and failed beta-ocimene attempts are not target-route steps. The four successful total-synthesis branches and the explicit racemic oxidation control are included.
issues.subject: model experiments

issues.detail: SI page 28 procedure says oxidation for 2 h, whereas its arrow says overnight. No harmonized duration is assigned.
issues.subject: E18

issues.detail: Source chiral silver catalysts are retained as named/source-labelled agents, not assigned speculative solution-complex SMILES.
issues.subject: S5/S6
